_note: Edit this file to change which steps exist and how they depend on each other. It holds GENERAL LIFEPATH guidance only: a step is created only when the notice (reviewed items) supports it. depends_on here is a general flow, shown to users as 'general flow', not as a rule from the notice.

guidance.why_it_matters: Applying without meeting the conditions can waste your time and fees.
guidance.what_to_do: Compare each condition below with your own marks, subjects and circumstances.

guidance.why_it_matters: Missing or wrongly formatted documents are a common reason applications are delayed.
guidance.what_to_do: Collect the mandatory documents. Prepare the conditional ones only if their condition applies to you.

guidance.why_it_matters: Registration is normally what gives you access to the application form.
guidance.what_to_do: Follow the registration instructions quoted below.

steps.title: Fill in and submit the application form

guidance.what_to_do: Complete the form as the notice describes and keep the confirmation.

guidance.why_it_matters: An unpaid fee can make an application invalid.
guidance.what_to_do: Pay through the method the notice allows and keep the receipt.

steps.title: Check the merit or rank list

guidance.why_it_matters: Your result decides which steps apply to you next.
guidance.what_to_do: Look for your name or rank, then record your result in LIFEPATH.

confirm_official_notice.title: Read the full notice and confirm key dates on the official website

guidance.why_it_matters: LIFEPATH summarises documents and can make mistakes. Notices are also revised.
guidance.what_to_do: Read the original notice end to end and check the official website for revisions.

no_instructions.title_template: Check the official instructions for what happens if your result is '{outcome}'

guidance.why_it_matters: The uploaded documents do not describe this situation, so LIFEPATH cannot tell you what to do.
guidance.what_to_do: Check the university's official instructions or contact the admissions office.
